added: Device Sync now carries your own figures from the Glossary, your notes on built-in figures, the Custom Figures setting and your shorthands for your own figures, once every device connected to your store has this version of the app or a later one. Until then changes to them aren't sent to your other devices, and Device Sync names the device holding them back. Because of this, the screen for connecting a device now says that every device needs an up-to-date app: one on an earlier version may not be able to connect.

Add the `glossaryEntry` and `figureNote` sync record kinds, with `StoredUserGlossaryEntry`, `UserGlossaryRepository.writeFromSync` and `FigureNoteRepository.writeFromSync`. A glossary entry's kind and payload travel as stored text, so sync keeps and republishes byte for byte an entry a build cannot read; its `createdAt` travels unchanged.
`SyncCapabilityPolicy.build` gates both kinds on `glossary.v1` and advertises it.
